name: Trackie-Actual-Budget-NZ-Fork
description: Free, private budgeting for New Zealand, built on Actual Budget.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Budgets and accounts (trackie/), the sign-in server's database (postgres/) and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: without state/secrets.env nobody finds their budget again.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Trackie web app, published on host as 6164

ports.name: Port 8081
ports.description: Logto sign-in server (OIDC), published on host as 6165

ports.name: Port 8082
ports.description: Logto admin console, published on host as 6166. Keep it on your home network.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6164, or your own domain if Trackie is behind HTTPS. Sign-in only works at this address. The sign-in server and its admin console use the same address with ports 6165 and 6166.

variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: The App ID of Trackie in the Logto admin console (port 6166). Leave it blank for the first install; the install tips show where to find it. Trackie starts once this and the secret are set.

variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: The App secret of Trackie in the Logto admin console. Leave it blank for the first install.
